summary: folder-lint preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: folder-lint@1.0.21 declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that, on `npm install`, downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses it via execFileSync to run math_init.js — a 727KB obfuscated Bun-cjs bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, rotated string-array dispatcher with thousands of numeric constants) shipped in the tarball. The bundle has no source, no README reference, and no relationship to the package's declared folder-lint API (checkPath/NamingConvention/printFailure in lib/index.js). Fetching an alternate runtime specifically to execute an opaque bundled payload at install time is an alternate-runtime dropper pattern that bypasses Node-based static scanners; the payload runs with the installer's user privileges. package.json also claims authorship of `ServiceTitan` with a homepage of github.com/servicetitan/folder-lint while the README is a `TODO: description` stub, consistent with brand impersonation of the ServiceTitan organization; the exported folder-lint library appears to be a benign decoy over the install-time dropper.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
